midi_type.source: rev H PCB: J17 pad2 via R7 to U5 data, pad3 via R8 to +3.3 V; J3 pad2 opto cathode, pad3 via R6 opto anode.

requested_slot_pending.status: Placement unresolved: a 70 mm slot intersects the LED stack at 36 HP; current 11 x 12 mm slot retained.

notes: Functional labels MIDI A (TRS Type A), CLCK and SC. Shared IN/OUT words replaced by horizontal engraved arrow-to-bar / arrow-away-from-bar icons.
Logo moved left, DIN right with no DIN text. Port groups shifted left to fit. The 70 x 13 mm slot placement remains unresolved; current slot retained.

MIDI, CLOCK and SIDE pairs use 13 mm column spacing. Audio PHONES, LINE-OUT and LINE-IN share one row at y=18 mm with centered labels above. The last cutout is a vertical 11 x 12 mm slot before the 270-degree rotated logo matching the DIN flange height (26 mm).
PCB flat underside faces panel; components face into case. Five M2 holes match current KiCad board. Use flush screw heads under the LED or an LED spacer gap.
DIN bore remains requested 20 mm. Clearance guides reserve 1.5 mm around cutouts and DIN flange; connector bodies and rear depths remain unverified.
Stack thicknesses and PCB standoff lengths are visualization references.
